summary: This directory manages the structured representation of JSDoc comments extracted from source code. It serves as a central location for defining the data contracts and models used to hold the analysis results of parsed JSDoc components within the application.
responsibilities: Define the data structures for extracted JSDoc information
Provide consistent models for parsed documentation components
Encapsulate the output format of JSDoc analysis
relationships: The analysis results contain the individual parsed JSDoc components.
The extracted JSDoc interface acts as a container for all relevant documentation metadata.
designDecisions: Use of interfaces to enforce strict data contracts
Centralization of data models for documentation analysis
